About

Exploring how language models reason, learn from evidence, and understand the limits of their knowledge.

My work explores language model reasoning, reinforcement learning, retrieval-augmented generation, and preference alignment, with an interest in reliable and data-efficient learning.

This page brings together selected research and ways to get in touch. For my full publication record, please visit Google Scholar ↗.

TraPO: A Semi-Supervised Reinforcement Learning Framework for Boosting LLM Reasoning ↗

Shenzhi Yang, Guangcheng Zhu, Haobo Wang, Xing Zheng, Yingfan Ma, Zhongqi Chen, Bowen Song, Weiqiang Wang, Junbo Zhao, Gang Chen

TraPO selects reliable unlabeled samples through learning trajectory similarity, enabling semi-supervised reinforcement learning to improve language model reasoning with fewer labels.
